display_name: Dharmapala & Atiśa of the Pāla Mahāvihāras
one_line: Pāla emperor Dharmapala and the scholar-monk Atiśa, linked by the great Buddhist mahāvihāras of eastern India.

appearance.age_look: Dharmapala appears in his late 30s, tall and lean but dignified; Atiśa appears in his early 30s, slightly shorter, with a calm monastic build.
appearance.face: Both share medium-brown eastern Indian complexions; Dharmapala has an oval face with sharp nose, trimmed moustache, neatly defined jaw and a steady, assessing gaze, default expression a composed, confident half-smile; Atiśa has a softer oval face, straight nose, fine eyebrows, no facial hair, and a serene, attentive expression with slightly upturned anime eyes suggesting quiet insight.
appearance.hair: Dharmapala’s hair is thick, black, gathered into a smooth topknot (small high bun) at the back of the crown with a narrow gold circlet resting low on the forehead; Atiśa’s head is closely shaven with a faint stubble texture, uncovered.
appearance.costume: Dharmapala wears an era-accurate Pāla royal outfit: a long, finely woven deep-red cotton- silk uttariya draped over both shoulders and across the chest like a cloak, trimmed with narrow gold borders; underneath a knee-length, cream-colored angarkha-style tunic with a subtle woven pattern, side-tied with a slim sash; lower garment is a mustard-ochre dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated in front, falling to the ankles; he has simple brown leather sandals, a broad golden waist-belt with a central lotus motif, a pair of modest gold armlets on the upper arms, thin bangles at the wrists, and small round gold stud earrings; Atiśa wears a simple saffron to deep-ochre monk’s robe (civara) in the eastern Indian style: an under-robe of lighter saffron visible at the neck and ankles, and a large outer robe of rich, slightly darker ochre draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm, with stitched patchwork panels; his robe is plain cotton, slightly worn but clean, with a narrow dark-red border; he goes barefoot, with ankles and wrists unadorned save for a slim wooden rosary wrapped twice around his left wrist.
appearance.signature: Dharmapala carries a sheathed straight steel sword with a simple cross-guard and a brown leather scabbard, the wooden hilt wrapped in dark-red cloth, worn at his left hip; Atiśa carries a carefully bound stack of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with red cord and a narrow wooden reading stick tucked under the cord.

ref_desc: Dharmapala is a lean, medium-brown Pāla emperor with a black topknot, gold circlet, deep-red cloak over cream tunic and mustard-ochre dhoti, sword at his hip, beside the shaven-headed Atiśa in plain saffron patchwork robes holding tied palm-leaf manuscripts, in a red, ochre, cream and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two historically grounded Pāla-era figures who must be redrawn consistently: first, Emperor Dharmapala, a tall lean eastern Indian man in his late 30s with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and confident half-smile, hair thick and black gathered into a smooth topknot with a narrow gold circlet low on his forehead; he wears a finely woven deep-red cotton-silk uttariya draped over both shoulders like a cloak, a knee-length cream angarkha-style tunic with subtle weaving, a tightly wrapped mustard-ochre dhoti falling to his ankles, brown leather sandals, a broad golden belt with a lotus motif, modest gold armlets, thin wrist bangles and small round gold stud earrings, and at his left hip a sheathed straight steel sword with a simple cross-guard and brown leather scabbard, the hilt wrapped in dark-red cloth. Beside him, show Atiśa, slightly shorter, early 30s, medium-brown complexion, soft oval face, straight nose, fine eyebrows, no facial hair, serene attentive expression and large anime eyes, his head closely shaven; he wears a simple saffron monk’s under-robe visible at the neck and ankles and a darker ochre outer robe with patchwork stitching draped over his left shoulder and under his right arm, bare feet, no jewellery, and a slim wooden rosary wrapped around his left wrist while he holds a neatly tied stack of palm-leaf manuscripts bound with red cord and a narrow wooden reading stick under the cord; keep the dominant colours deep red, mustard ochre, cream, gold and saffron, with clear front and side views emphasizing consistent face shapes, hairstyles, drapery of garments and the sword and manuscripts as their signature props.
